defect: an asynchronous FIFO pointer crosses as binary code instead of a Gray-coded pointer
rationale: wptr_bin_a can change multiple bits at one source transition, so direct sampling in clk_b can create an invalid FIFO position and full indication.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A multi-bit binary write pointer is sampled across domains, so several bits changing at once can be captured inconsistently; Gray coding is required.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the independent write and read pointer domains and destination full comparison, reduced the storage path and assertions, and exposed the pointer transfer in a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Transferred wptr_bin_a directly into the read clock domain instead of converting and synchronizing a Gray-coded write pointer.
